comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus aim and lock a loaded inspection arm at 15 degrees.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part alignment across posts, compliant insertion and screw fastening versus supporting a rotating load while tightening a hinge lock.
comparison.success_condition: Four-prong retention and prescribed screws versus a released arm holding within 3 degrees of target for 2 seconds.
comparison.reason: Both require support during locking, but one establishes rack attachment while the other sets an angular mechanism. Candidate numeric retention-load criteria are missing.
